# Transaction wire fixtures

These fixed base64 strings were assembled independently from the Borsh field
layout (little-endian integer/string/vector lengths), not generated by the Rust
serializer under test. They encode a transfer of 123 yoctoNEAR from alice.near to
bob.near, nonce 42, Ed25519 public key bytes `[7; 32]`, and block hash `[9; 32]`.
Signed fixtures use Ed25519 signature bytes `[11; 64]`: these are encoding fixtures,
not valid signatures. The V1 fixture uses gas-key nonce index 3 and strict mode.
The delegate fixture expires at block 1000.

V0 has no version prefix. V1 starts with byte 1 and includes the gas-key nonce
discriminant, a u16 nonce index, and the strict nonce-mode discriminant. The transfer
action discriminant is 3; its deposit is u128. Public keys and signatures have the
Ed25519 discriminant 0.
